name: Ren'ai Hakyoku Ukeoinin
source:
Main character is a student helping at the detective office of his uncle. One day he receives a case to help a man divorce with his low quality wife. But no one expected the man to be kissing another man in secret! Protagonist's mindset gets greatly influenced by this fact - from now on he starts to manipulate minds of people. He gets either love or madness.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-september-2004-abandoner.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名在叔叔侦探事务所帮忙的学生。一天，他接到委托，要协助一名男子与糟糕的妻子离婚。然而谁也没想到，那个男人竟在暗中亲吻另一个男人！这一事实极大影响了主人公的想法——从此，他开始操纵人心。他最终得到的，可能是爱情，也可能是疯狂。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-september-2004-abandoner.html]vndbreview[/url]]
